Name: Updated No More Bowlegs
Author: Leroymilo
Description:
[size=6]This is an update of the classic mod No More Bowlegs for Stardew Valley 1.6
[b]Made from scratch for Content Patcher[/b][/size]

This mod includes :
[list]
[*]Abigail (Normal and Winter)
[*]Caroline (Winter)
[*]Elliott (Normal, Beach and Winter)
[*]Harvey (Normal, Beach and Winter)

[*]Jodi (Normal and Winter)
[*]Leah (Normal and Winter)
[*]Maru (Normal, Hospital and Winter)
[/list]
If you'd like to see other bowlegs removed, you can ask it in a post on this mod page.

Here are some samples :
